title: lithocarpus hypoglaucus
intro: Lithocarpus hypoglaucus, commonly known as the Burmese beech or Himalayan beech, is a species of plant in the beech family (Fagaceae). This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, particularly for its ability to lower blood sugar levels and provide relief from digestive issues. The health benefits of Lithocarpus hypoglaucus include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
